name: MarqueeX – Smooth Marquee Slider & News ticker for Gutenberg & Elementor
author: WPXERO

sections.description:
🚀 MarqueeX is the ultimate WordPress marquee plugin designed specifically for Gutenberg and Elementor page builders. Create stunning scrolling content, news tickers, announcement banners, and infinite content sliders with dedicated Elementor widgets and native Gutenberg blocks. No coding required!

Native Page Builder Integration

🎨 Elementor Widgets Included:
* Image Marquee Widget – Smooth scrolling image galleries
* Text Marquee Widget – Dynamic text animations and sliders
* News Ticker Widget – Professional news feeds and announcements
* Full Elementor visual editor integration with live preview

📝 Gutenberg Block Support:
* Native MarqueeX block for Gutenberg editor
* Seamless integration with all WordPress blocks
* Visual block settings panel with real-time preview
* Compatible with Full Site Editing (FSE) themes

Why Choose MarqueeX for Your Page Builder

  • Elementor & Gutenberg Native Integration – Built specifically for WordPress page builders
  • Create professional news tickers & announcement banners
  • Build scrolling text sliders & dynamic content carousels
  • Showcase testimonials, product highlights, and client logos
  • SEO-optimized markup for better search rankings
  • Fully responsive design on all devices
  • Lightweight & fast loading for optimal performance
  • Visual drag & drop controls in both Elementor and Gutenberg
  • WCAG accessibility compliant for inclusive design

Key Features for Page Builders

🎯 Page Builder Optimization
* Native Elementor widgets with visual controls
* Gutenberg block with intuitive settings panel
* Live preview in both Elementor and Gutenberg editors
* Seamless theme integration and compatibility

🎬 Advanced Animation Controls
* Multi-directional marquee (left, right, up, down)
* Adjustable speed, timing, and easing effects
* Pause on hover & infinite scrolling loops
* Smooth CSS3 animations for better performance

🎨 Design & Customization
* Rich typography and color options
* Multiple layout styles and templates
* Custom CSS support for advanced styling
* Responsive breakpoint controls

⚡ Performance & SEO Benefits
* SEO-friendly HTML structure for better rankings
* Optimized CSS and JavaScript loading
* Schema markup support for rich snippets
* Core Web Vitals optimized animations

Perfect for Every Website & Page Builder Workflow

  • 📰 News & Magazine Sites – scrolling headlines with Elementor News Ticker widget
  • 🛍️ eCommerce Stores – product sliders using Elementor Image Marquee
  • 💼 Business Websites – client logos and testimonials with Gutenberg blocks
  • 🎉 Event Sites – upcoming events and schedules
  • 🎨 Portfolio Sites – work samples and image galleries
  • 📢 Marketing Pages – promotional banners and announcements

Quick Start Guide

For Elementor Users:
1. Install & Activate MarqueeX
2. Edit any page with Elementor
3. Make sure turn on the Elementor in MarqueeX Dashboard
4. Find MarqueeX widgets in the elements panel
5. Drag Image Marquee, Text Marquee, or News Ticker widgets
6. Customize settings and add content
7. Preview & Publish!

For Gutenberg Users:
1. Install & Activate MarqueeX
2. Edit any page/post with Gutenberg
3. Make sure turn on the Gutenberg in MarqueeX Dashboard
4. Add MarqueeX block from block inserter
5. Configure animation and design settings
6. Add your content and publish!
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “MarqueeX”
  3. Click “Install Now” then “Activate”
  4. Select with page builder you are using in MarqueeX Dashboard
  5. For Elementor: Find MarqueeX widgets in Elementor editor
  6. For Gutenberg: Add MarqueeX block to any page/post
  7. Customize settings and add your content
sections.faq:
Does MarqueeX work with Elementor?

Yes! MarqueeX includes native Elementor widgets: Image Marquee, Text Marquee, and News Ticker widgets with full visual editor integration.

Is it compatible with Gutenberg blocks?

Absolutely! MarqueeX provides a native Gutenberg block that works seamlessly with all WordPress blocks and Full Site Editing themes.

Will it work with my theme and page builder?

Yes! MarqueeX is designed for maximum compatibility with any WordPress theme supporting Gutenberg or Elementor page builders.

Can I use both Elementor widgets and Gutenberg blocks?

Definitely! You can use MarqueeX Elementor widgets on Elementor pages and Gutenberg blocks on regular WordPress pages or posts.

How do I create a horizontal marquee in Elementor?

Simply drag the Image Marquee or Text Marquee widget to your Elementor page, configure the direction settings, and add your content.

Are the animations SEO-friendly?

Yes! All MarqueeX animations use SEO-optimized HTML markup and CSS3 animations that don’t impact search engine crawling.

Can I control animation speed and direction?

Full control over scroll speed, direction (left, right, up, down), timing, and easing effects in both Elementor and Gutenberg.

What content can I display in marquees?

Any content! Text, images, videos, buttons, custom HTML, and even other Gutenberg blocks or Elementor elements.
